ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota DHS Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds within the Minnesota Department of Human Services to identify potential areas of fraud
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What are the biggest areas of expenditure within the Minnesota DHS?
Are there any unusual or unexplained transactions?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the flow of funds within the Minnesota DHS, we may be able to identify potential areas of fraud and determine the extent of the problem. This investigation could involve reviewing public records and conducting data analysis to identify unusual or unexplained transactions.
